newsitem.title: USA: Ashland to shut Kentucky refinery unit.
newsitem.headline: Ashland to shut Kentucky refinery unit.

text.p: Ashland Inc plans to shut down the reduced crude cracker at its 219,000 barrels per day (bpd) refinery in Catlettsburg, Kentucky beginning on July 25, a trade source familiar with the plant's operations said on Friday.
The shutdown was scheduled for the autumn, but the company had to move it up, the source said.
The closure is expected to reduce crude runs by around 20,000 bpd in August.
It remained unclear why Ashland decided to bring forward the scheduled shutdown.
